title: Require effective, not nominal, human oversight of AI
requirements:
- Define assistive use by the system's actual role and influence
- Describe human oversight as a behavioural and organisational capability, not just the presence of a reviewer
- Articulate human-in-the-loop oversight principles
- Consider a cross-cutting principle preserving transparency, accountability and override where automated processing materially affects people or institutions
- Require proportionate exception and review where evidence is incomplete or conflicting
- Require an operational oversight model proportionate to risk, addressing automation bias and review capacity
- Address automation bias and over-reliance, especially in low-resource settings
- Cover fairness, safety, transparency, explainability and lifecycle governance
